stories.title: Bucks 116, Raptors 111 — Tyler Herro 32, Milwaukee Ends 13-Game Losing Streak

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Tyler Herro had the career-high 50 on Saturday.

The Bucks still lost.

Then he came back Monday with 32 points and ended Milwaukee's 13-game losing streak.

That's the range. #Bucks

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Milwaukee was 1-14. They had lost 13 in a row.

Then Tyler Herro dropped 32 and the Bucks beat the Raptors 116-111 on Monday.

The streak is over. #Bucks
